title: Token-2022 mint close authority
detects: An address that can close the mint account once supply reaches zero, freeing the address to be re-initialised as a different token with different rules.
knownFalseNegative: Read as upgradeability rather than admin-authority because the consequence is that the token at a fixed address can be replaced wholesale. Every integrator, wallet and price feed keys off the mint address, and this power invalidates that assumption. The zero-supply precondition looks like a constraint and is not an independent one when the same party also holds the permanent delegate or the mint authority: burning the supply to zero and then closing the mint is a single actor's sequence. Check who holds the other authorities before reading the precondition as protection.

coversExamples.observed: PRESENT, closeAuthority 2apBGMsS6ti9RyF5TwQTDswXBWskiJP2LD4cUEDqYJjk, the same key that holds the permanent delegate and every other authority on this mint

rationale: Without this a token can be closed and a different token re-initialised at the same address, and nothing in the score would have mentioned that the address itself is not a durable identity.
